name: codecity
description: CodeCity AI — monorepo runner (auth + analyzer + web)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n AUTH,ANALYZER,WEB -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix auth-server run dev" "npm --prefix analyzer run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n AUTH,ANALYZER,WEB -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix auth-server start" "npm --prefix analyzer start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix auth-server install && npm --prefix analyzer install && npm --prefix frontend install
